title: Joint agency EEG dataset
description: This dataset contains behavioural and EEG hyperscanning data collected from 32 pairs of participants performing a musical joint action task. The data were collected to examine cognitive and neural signals underlying the sense of joint agency during synchronized musical performance. Each pair's data includes behavioural ratings and synchronization measures alongside dual-participant 64-channel EEG recordings in BrainVision format.
methods_description: EEG hyperscanning data were recorded simultaneously from pairs of participants using a 32-channel setup per participant (64 channels total), stored in BrainVision format (.eeg, .vhdr, .vmrk). Behavioural data include joint agency ratings, synchronization performance metrics (mean and standard deviation of note-onset asynchronies), and trial/block/condition markers. Participants performed musical duets and constant pitch sequences while EEG and tone onset events were time-locked via event markers.
